title: AI Assurance common diagnostic run contract
description: Version-discriminated diagnostic contract: legacy 1.0, hosted 1.1, authenticated external audit projection 1.2, engine report 1.3, hosted run 1.4 and compiled external audit run 1.5 under statistics 1.0.0 (docs/design/audit-statistics.md). Schema validity is distinct from result origin, input custody, statistical suitability and legal sufficiency.

parameters.description: Validated against the selected test registry schema; cannot contain arbitrary executable code or SQL.

interactiveThresholds.description: Prototype calculator settings; production approval/provenance is a separate gate.

slice.description: Minimized/pseudonymized labels. Avoid exposing small sensitive groups in client exports.

isolation.const: SQLite read transaction; mode=ro; query_only; no user SQL

inputHashes.description: Actual consumed artifacts only. Saved-prediction runner hashes data/reference; it must not invent a model hash.

card.description: Frozen dataset governance card; application validation enforces its version, artifact hash, and engagement.

hostedRun.description: Hosted v1.1 saved-prediction execution with frozen model/card, dataset, protocol and configuration snapshots. SHA-256 values describe content; authenticity and cross-field equality require the application validator.

planBand.description: Inclusive acceptable region. At least one bound is a number.

planLibraryEntry.description: A versioned threshold-library entry (section 10.1). parameters holds every parameter value after defaults; overriddenParameters names those that differ from the entry's defaults.

planPerformanceCriterion.description: Binary performance. An empty members array only occurs in a derived plan whose policy sets no performance threshold (no_threshold).

passBlockedBy.description: Derived plans only (section 4.8): R2, which today's engine rule requires to meet a threshold and which 1.0.0 cannot decide, blocks a pass (undecidable_metric).

planGroupCriterion.description: A null band only occurs in a derived plan whose policy sets no value for this criterion (no_threshold).

groupFields.description: Protected columns; several make intersectional strata. Null means the configuration's protected-group column.

planCalibrationCriterion.description: Engine only. band is the per-bin calibration-gap band (null in a derived plan); members may add a Brier-score maximum.

subgroup.description: Per-group calibration: restrict the criterion to rows whose field equals value.

passBlockedBy.description: Derived plans only (section 4.8): the expected calibration error, which today's engine rule requires to meet a threshold and which 1.0.0 cannot decide, blocks a pass (undecidable_metric).

statisticsPlan.description: Live contract for docs/design/audit-statistics.md section 9, copied from the design draft docs/design/audit-statistics-plan.schema.json for #21 (engine configuration 1.3 and report 1.3) and #22. It accepts a plan as written (omitted fields take the listed defaults) and the normalised plan (every field present). The plan hash is the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the normalised plan. Rules that JSON Schema cannot state are normative in section 9 and enforced by engine/statistics.py validate_plan: criterion ids are unique, a band must satisfy the section 3 table (new plans are rejected; derived legacy plans evaluate an invalid band as invalid_band), a library-derived band must equal the band its entry produces, and minimums never fall below the floors. schemas/.build-run-schema.py embeds this file as $defs.statisticsPlan of test-run.schema.json.

then.description: passBlockedBy is set only by legacy derivation (section 9.3).

minimums.description: Applied minimums. Each is at least its floor (30, 30, 10).

configuredMinimums.description: The minimums a legacy configuration specified, recorded beside the applied max(floor, configured) values. Null for plans that were not derived.

derivedFrom.description: Set when the plan was derived from a legacy configuration (section 9).

inputHashes.description: Actual consumed artifacts only. Saved-prediction runner hashes data/reference; it must not invent a model hash.

engineReport.description: Engine report under statistics 1.0.0: every performance, calibration and group criterion of the recorded plan is one result with a decision; drift, unavailable capabilities and model-backed procedures keep the 1.0 result shape without one.

card.description: Frozen dataset governance card; application validation enforces its version, artifact hash, and engagement.

externalPredictionDataset.description: External immutable input snapshot. rowCount is the maximum reported metric sample size in this projection, not a verified source-population census.

externalAuditRun.description: Authenticated external attempt projected into an audit run. Exact external report bytes remain preserved separately; application validation enforces request, lease, nonce, input and authority bindings.

externalStatisticsRun.description: Authenticated external attempt under statistics 1.0.0: results are the criteria of the recorded plan, each with the engine decision the worker copied; exploratory criteria never change the outcome and failing ones are reviewFlags.

hostedStatisticsRun.description: Hosted saved-prediction run under statistics 1.0.0: one result per criterion of the plan frozen in manifest.statistics, decided by its interval against the pre-registered band; exploratory criteria never change the outcome and failing ones are reviewFlags. SHA-256 values describe content; cross-field equality requires the application validator.
